codes.badRequest: The request could not be understood. Check what you entered and try again.
codes.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
codes.codeNotRecognised: We could not find a report for that code. Check the code and try again.
codes.invalidCredentials: Those details were not accepted. Check them and try again.
codes.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.conflict: This changed while you were working. Refresh and try again.
codes.idempotencyConflict: This request was already used with different details. Start again.
codes.notAllowedNow: That action is not available in the current state.

codes.markupNotAllowed: Remove formatting or markup and try again.

codes.invalidCursor: That page of results is no longer valid. Return to the first page.
codes.queryChanged: The search changed. Review the new plan before continuing.
codes.notVerified: This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
codes.timeout: The service took too long to respond. Try again.
codes.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
codes.network: Could not reach ShaidaGo. Check your connection and try again.
codes.internal: Something went wrong on our side.

trust.heading: How you can check what you read
trust.sources: Every fact links to the source it came from, with the exact passage and the date it was checked.
trust.review: A person reviews evidence before it changes a public record. Automated tools explain and search, but they are not sources.
trust.privacy: Reports are private by default and are never published automatically.
